Phobos.Radio.BandDef.label: VHF (2 m)
Phobos.Radio.BandDef.description: 144 to 148 MHz. Line of sight; cheap, light and reliable outdoors, but blocked by terrain and heavy walls.

Phobos.Radio.BandDef.label: UHF (70 cm)
Phobos.Radio.BandDef.description: 430 to 450 MHz. Shorter line of sight than VHF, but copes better inside buildings and mountain bases.
